text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Like I said, I'm not gonna be your dog!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Works for me. You're gonna celebrate my 
birthday, right?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Don't be so stubborn, it's just a little 
fun. ...Become my dog, Ace.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Why, you ask?! More like, as a dog owner, 
that phrasing really ticks me off... Don't 
treat dogs like they're disposable!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? In that case, you truly ought to 
become my dog. Why, you ask? Because—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Hey. Sirius, why didn't you tell me?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Told me to become a dog. Personally, I 
think I'd make an easy pet to keep.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Come on, think about it. It eats on its 
own, goes on walks on its own. It'll live 
just fine even if you leave it alone, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, before that, CB, why are you so 
open to being kept as a pet?! You hate 
that kind of stuff the most, don't you?!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Of course I hate being tied down. But 
Sirius seems like she'd let me do my own 
thing, so it might actually be hassle-free 
and easy.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Easy, huh. ...I've changed my mind. CB, 
I'll keep you as a pet too.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Just how much do I dote on my pack, you 
ask...? —I'll train you until you've got 
it memorized. Where's your answer?
